disclaimer: For reflection and entertainment. Not professional advice.

crystals.name: Citrine
crystals.summary: Citrine is a sunny yellow quartz known in shops as the merchant's stone. Many people keep it as a cheerful reminder to welcome good opportunities.
crystals.how_to_use: Hold it for a minute while you set one clear money goal. Keep it near where you plan, budget or work.
crystals.placement: Southeast corner of the living room or desk, traditionally linked to wealth. A cashier area works well too.
crystals.care: Rinse briefly in water and dry well. Avoid long direct sun, as the colour can fade over time.
crystals.avoid_note: Many low-cost pieces are heat-treated amethyst. That is fine, just know what you buy.

crystals.name: Pyrite
crystals.summary: Pyrite is a shiny golden mineral often called fool's gold. It is a popular symbol of steady effort and building savings.
crystals.how_to_use: Place a cube or cluster where you do paperwork. Touch it before a big task to feel focused.
crystals.placement: Southeast of the home or the left corner of your desk.
crystals.care: Keep dry. Water can make it rust or tarnish. Dust with a soft brush and charge on a quartz plate.
crystals.avoid_note: Do not soak in water or salt water.

crystals.name: Amethyst
crystals.summary: Amethyst is a purple quartz loved for its calm, gentle look. Many people use it as a quiet signal to slow down and rest.
crystals.how_to_use: Hold it while taking five slow breaths before bed. Keep a small tumble in your bag for busy days.
crystals.placement: Bedroom side table or a quiet reading corner. Northeast is linked to study and reflection.
crystals.care: Rinse in water and dry. Keep out of direct sun, which can fade the purple.
crystals.avoid_note: Keep away from sunny windowsills to protect the colour.

crystals.name: Black Obsidian
crystals.summary: Black obsidian is natural volcanic glass with a deep, glossy shine. It is widely worn as a grounding and protective charm.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear as a bracelet on your left wrist, as many local sellers suggest. Pause and touch it when you feel scattered.
crystals.placement: Near the main door, facing inward, or on a work desk.
crystals.care: Rinse with water and wipe dry. Handle with care, as edges can chip.
crystals.avoid_note: Raw pieces can be sharp. Choose polished forms for daily wear.

crystals.name: Black Obsidian Pixiu
crystals.summary: The pixiu is a mythical beast said to gather wealth and guard it. Carved in obsidian, it is one of the most popular charms in Singapore shops.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear the bead with the pixiu head facing outward on your wrist. Greet it kindly now and then as a small habit of gratitude.
crystals.placement: On a desk or shelf facing the main door or a window, never facing a toilet or mirror.
crystals.care: Rinse gently with water and dry. Some owners avoid letting others touch it, as a matter of tradition.
crystals.avoid_note: Tradition says not to wear it in the bathroom or to bed.

crystals.name: Rose Quartz
crystals.summary: Rose quartz is a soft pink stone linked with kindness and love. It is a gentle reminder to be warm to yourself and others.
crystals.how_to_use: Hold it while you name one thing you appreciate about yourself. Place a pair together to symbolise partnership.
crystals.placement: Southwest of the bedroom, traditionally linked to relationships. A pair of pieces is customary.
crystals.care: Rinse in water and dry. Avoid long sun, which can pale the pink.
crystals.avoid_note: Sun-fading. Keep off bright windowsills.

crystals.name: Clear Quartz
crystals.summary: Clear quartz is the classic all-purpose crystal. Many people use it to support whatever intention they set.
crystals.how_to_use: Write a goal on paper and set the quartz on top. Use a quartz plate to rest other stones.
crystals.placement: Northwest or west of the home, or the centre of a desk for focus.
crystals.care: Rinse with water, dry, and rest in moonlight. Very hardy and easy to care for.
crystals.avoid_note: Clusters can concentrate sunlight. Keep away from curtains in strong sun.

crystals.name: Tiger's Eye
crystals.summary: Tiger's eye has silky golden bands that shimmer as it moves. It is a favourite for courage and steady decisions at work.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it on interview or meeting days. Rub it gently as a cue to speak calmly and clearly.
crystals.placement: North of the office, linked to career, or on the right side of your desk.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Charge in morning sun for a short time.
crystals.avoid_note: Polished beads can scratch. Store apart from harder stones.

crystals.name: Jade
crystals.summary: Jade has been treasured in Chinese culture for thousands of years. It stands for virtue, harmony and good fortune.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear a bangle or pendant close to the skin. Tradition says jade grows richer as you wear it daily.
crystals.placement: East of the home, linked to family, or worn on the body.
crystals.care: Wipe with a soft damp cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals and hard knocks.
crystals.avoid_note: Prices vary hugely. Buy certified jadeite from trusted shops for high-value pieces.

crystals.name: Green Aventurine
crystals.summary: Green aventurine is a soft green stone with a light sparkle. It is often called a lucky stone for new chances.
crystals.how_to_use: Carry a tumble in your wallet or pocket. Hold it when starting something new.
crystals.placement: East or southeast of the home, near healthy plants.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Limit long sun exposure to keep the colour.
crystals.avoid_note: Some green stones are dyed. Ask the shop if unsure.

crystals.name: Black Tourmaline
crystals.summary: Black tourmaline is a ridged black crystal often used as a protective stone. It is a symbol of firm boundaries and calm strength.
crystals.how_to_use: Place one by the door as a reminder to leave stress outside. Hold it when you need to feel grounded.
crystals.placement: Beside the main door or in the corners of a room.
crystals.care: Dust with a brush or rinse quickly and dry. Raw pieces can flake.
crystals.avoid_note: Raw sticks are brittle. Avoid dropping.

crystals.name: Smoky Quartz
crystals.summary: Smoky quartz is a tea-coloured quartz with a steady, earthy feel. Many people use it to help release worry at the end of the day.
crystals.how_to_use: Hold it and name one thing you can let go of today. Keep it near the door or bed.
crystals.placement: Northeast or the centre of the home, linked to Earth.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Keep out of strong sun to avoid fading.
crystals.avoid_note: Very dark pieces may be irradiated. Ask the seller.

crystals.name: Carnelian
crystals.summary: Carnelian is a warm orange stone with a glowing look. It is linked with energy, courage and creative drive.
crystals.how_to_use: Keep it on your desk when you start a creative project. Hold it before you exercise or present.
crystals.placement: South of the home, linked to fame and recognition.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Charge in morning sun briefly.
crystals.avoid_note: Some carnelian is dyed agate. Natural colour is often uneven.

crystals.name: Moonstone
crystals.summary: Moonstone has a soft blue glow that moves like moonlight. It is tied to cycles, gentleness and new beginnings.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it during the new moon as a cue to set fresh intentions. Keep it by your journal.
crystals.placement: West of the bedroom or a quiet night-time corner.
crystals.care: Rinse gently and dry. Charge under moonlight. It is fairly soft, so avoid knocks.
crystals.avoid_note: Scratches easily. Store in a soft pouch.

crystals.name: Labradorite
crystals.summary: Labradorite looks grey until the light hits it, then flashes blue and gold. It is a symbol of hidden potential.
crystals.how_to_use: Turn it in the light while reflecting on a choice. Keep it near your journal.
crystals.placement: North of the home or a study desk.
crystals.care: Wipe with a soft damp cloth. Avoid long soaking.
crystals.avoid_note: Can crack along layers if dropped.

crystals.name: Lapis Lazuli
crystals.summary: Lapis lazuli is a deep blue stone with gold flecks, prized for centuries. It is linked to wisdom and honest speech.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it on days you need to speak up. Keep a piece on your study table.
crystals.placement: Northeast of the home, linked to knowledge.
crystals.care: Wipe with a dry or slightly damp cloth. Avoid water soaks and salt.
crystals.avoid_note: Soft and porous. No salt water.

crystals.name: Malachite
crystals.summary: Malachite has striking green bands like a peacock feather. It is seen as a stone for change and growth.
crystals.how_to_use: Use polished pieces only. Place it where you reflect on changes you want to make.
crystals.placement: East of the home, away from children's reach.
crystals.care: Keep dry. Dust gently. Never use water or salt.
crystals.avoid_note: Do not use raw malachite or make water with it. Wash hands after handling raw pieces.

crystals.name: Rhodochrosite
crystals.summary: Rhodochrosite is a rosy pink stone with gentle bands. It is linked to self-kindness and warm connection.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it close to the heart. Hold it when writing kind notes to yourself.
crystals.placement: Southwest of the bedroom.
crystals.care: Soft stone. Wipe with a dry cloth. Avoid water and sun.
crystals.avoid_note: Scratches easily and can fade. Handle gently.

crystals.name: Selenite
crystals.summary: Selenite is a soft white mineral with a silky shine. Many people use it as a resting plate to refresh other stones.
crystals.how_to_use: Rest bracelets on a selenite plate overnight. Run a wand slowly above your shoulders as a calming ritual.
crystals.placement: West or northwest of the home, on a dry shelf.
crystals.care: Never wet it. Water dissolves and damages selenite. Dust with a dry cloth.
crystals.avoid_note: Water-sensitive and very soft. Keep away from humid bathrooms.

crystals.name: Fluorite
crystals.summary: Fluorite comes in bands of purple and green and is called the study stone. It is a nice desk companion during exams.
crystals.how_to_use: Place it beside your books while studying. Touch it when you need to refocus.
crystals.placement: Northeast of the room or study desk.
crystals.care: Soft and can fade. Wipe dry, avoid sun and long soaking.
crystals.avoid_note: Chips easily. Keep away from sun.

crystals.name: Garnet
crystals.summary: Garnet is a deep red stone named after pomegranate seeds. It is linked to warmth, loyalty and energy.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it as a bracelet on days you want to feel bold. Gift it as a symbol of friendship.
crystals.placement: South of the home.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Hardy and easy to care for.
crystals.avoid_note: Very dark beads may look black indoors. Check in daylight.

crystals.name: Hematite
crystals.summary: Hematite is a heavy, mirror-like metallic stone. It is used as a grounding reminder on hectic days.
crystals.how_to_use: Hold it in your palm and feel its weight for a minute. Wear it on busy workdays.
crystals.placement: West or northwest of the office.
crystals.care: Keep dry. It can rust. Wipe with a dry cloth.
crystals.avoid_note: Most shop bracelets are man-made hematine. Still fine as decor.

crystals.name: Howlite
crystals.summary: Howlite is a white stone with fine grey veins. It is often used as a calming stone for patience.
crystals.how_to_use: Hold it and count ten slow breaths when frustrated. Keep it by your pillow.
crystals.placement: Bedroom or west side of the home.
crystals.care: Porous. Wipe with a damp cloth, avoid soaking and oils.
crystals.avoid_note: Often dyed to look like turquoise. Check labels.

crystals.name: Amazonite
crystals.summary: Amazonite is a soft teal stone with a fresh, breezy look. It is linked to honest words and calm courage.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it before hard conversations. Keep it beside your phone as a cue to speak kindly.
crystals.placement: North of the home or on a work desk.
crystals.care: Rinse briefly and dry. Avoid long sun.
crystals.avoid_note: Can crack along planes. Handle gently.

crystals.name: Aquamarine
crystals.summary: Aquamarine is a pale sea-blue gem named after seawater. It is linked to calm seas and clear speech.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it when travelling as a calming charm. Hold it while journalling worries.
crystals.placement: North of the home, linked to Water.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Charge in moonlight.
crystals.avoid_note: Very bright blue may be glass. Buy from trusted sellers.

crystals.name: Sodalite
crystals.summary: Sodalite is a navy stone with white veins that looks like a night sky. It is a popular study and thinking stone.
crystals.how_to_use: Keep it by your laptop during deep work. Hold it while sorting out your thoughts.
crystals.placement: Northeast or north of a study room.
crystals.care: Wipe with a damp cloth and dry. Avoid long soaking.
crystals.avoid_note: Fairly soft. Store apart from harder stones.

crystals.name: Peridot
crystals.summary: Peridot is a bright lime-green gem with a cheerful glow. It is linked to growth and fresh starts.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it at the start of a new month. Keep a small piece in your wallet.
crystals.placement: East or southeast of the home.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Avoid sudden heat changes.
crystals.avoid_note: Can scratch. Store in a pouch.

crystals.name: Sunstone
crystals.summary: Sunstone has a warm orange sparkle like sunlight on water. It is linked with optimism and leadership.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it on days you need cheer. Hold it while listing three good things.
crystals.placement: South of the home, linked to recognition.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Charge briefly in morning sun.
crystals.avoid_note: Goldstone is man-made glass, sometimes sold as sunstone.

crystals.name: Strawberry Quartz
crystals.summary: Strawberry quartz is a pink quartz with tiny red flecks. In Singapore it is a popular stone for romance.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it on dates or social outings. Hold it while thinking of the kind of love you want.
crystals.placement: Southwest of the bedroom.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Keep out of strong sun.
crystals.avoid_note: Many are glass imitations. Look for natural inclusions.

crystals.name: Rutilated Quartz
crystals.summary: Rutilated quartz holds fine golden needles inside clear quartz. Locally it is a prized stone for career and wealth.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it for important business days. Keep a piece where you plan your goals.
crystals.placement: Northwest of the home, linked to mentors and helpful people.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Hardy stone.
crystals.avoid_note: Prices rise with needle density. Compare before buying.

crystals.name: Moss Agate
crystals.summary: Moss agate looks like a tiny garden trapped in stone. It is linked to patience and steady growth.
crystals.how_to_use: Keep it near your plants. Hold it when starting a slow, long-term goal.
crystals.placement: East of the home, linked to family and health.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Durable.
crystals.avoid_note: None major. Easy for beginners.

crystals.name: Blue Lace Agate
crystals.summary: Blue lace agate has soft sky-blue bands. It is a gentle stone for calm, kind words.
crystals.how_to_use: Hold it before a meeting and breathe slowly. Wear it near the throat.
crystals.placement: North of the home or a living room table.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Avoid strong sun.
crystals.avoid_note: Bright blue agate is often dyed.

crystals.name: Red Jasper
crystals.summary: Red jasper is a warm brick-red stone with a steady feel. It is linked to stamina and follow-through.
crystals.how_to_use: Keep it in your gym bag or desk drawer. Hold it when you need to finish a task.
crystals.placement: South or the centre of the home.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Very durable.
crystals.avoid_note: None major.

crystals.name: Lepidolite
crystals.summary: Lepidolite is a soft lilac stone with a sparkly mica sheen. Many people keep it as a calming bedtime stone.
crystals.how_to_use: Hold it during a short evening wind-down. Place it near your pillow.
crystals.placement: Bedroom side table.
crystals.care: Keep dry. It is soft and flaky. Dust gently.
crystals.avoid_note: Water-sensitive. Do not make crystal water with it.

crystals.name: Prehnite
crystals.summary: Prehnite is a soft green stone that often forms like grape bunches. It is linked to peace at home.
crystals.how_to_use: Place it in a shared family area. Hold it when you need patience with others.
crystals.placement: East of the living room.
crystals.care: Rinse briefly and dry. Avoid long sun.
crystals.avoid_note: Can fade in sun.

crystals.name: Amethyst Geode Cave
crystals.summary: An amethyst cave is a hollow rock lined with purple crystals. In Singapore it is a classic home and shop centrepiece for gathering good fortune.
crystals.how_to_use: Place it with the opening facing into the room. Some owners drop a coin inside each new month as a saving habit.
crystals.placement: Living room facing inward, or near the cashier. Avoid facing the main door directly outward.
crystals.care: Dust with a soft brush. Keep out of direct sun to protect the colour.
crystals.avoid_note: Heavy. Place on a stable stand away from children's reach.

crystals.name: Green Phantom Quartz
crystals.summary: Green phantom quartz has green layers inside like a hidden landscape. It is a well-known business luck stone in local shops.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it during new ventures. Keep a piece on your work desk.
crystals.placement: Southeast of the home or office.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Durable quartz.
crystals.avoid_note: Quality varies a lot. Compare clarity before buying.

crystals.name: Rhodonite
crystals.summary: Rhodonite is pink with dark veins. It is linked to forgiveness and mending bonds.
crystals.how_to_use: Hold it while writing a note to make peace. Keep it in shared rooms.
crystals.placement: Southwest of the living room.
crystals.care: Rinse briefly and dry.
crystals.avoid_note: None major.

crystals.name: Turquoise
crystals.summary: Turquoise is one of the oldest protective stones worn around the world. Its sky-blue colour is linked to safe journeys.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it when travelling. Touch it as a reminder to stay calm and kind.
crystals.placement: North of the home or worn as jewellery.
crystals.care: Porous. Keep away from water, perfume and oils. Wipe dry.
crystals.avoid_note: Many pieces are dyed howlite. Water-sensitive.

crystals.name: Red Agate
crystals.summary: Red agate is a traditional festive stone, often worn during Chinese New Year. Its red tone is linked to joy and good luck.
crystals.how_to_use: Wear it during festive season or your zodiac year. Gift it to loved ones.
crystals.placement: South of the home or worn on the body.
crystals.care: Rinse and dry. Durable.
crystals.avoid_note: Bright red is often dyed. Harmless but good to know.
